features.title: Share a thread as a read-only link
features.summary: Settings › Thread sharing creates a read-only share link for one thread: live (re-read and redacted on every view) or a snapshot frozen at creation; anyone with the unguessable link, or link plus a passphrase kept only as a salted scrypt hash; expiring in 1 hour, 1 day, 7 days or never. The link is shown once (only its SHA-256 is stored). The list shows active shares with view counts and revokes one behind a confirmation; expired and revoked shares stay visible behind a switch. The page is served by a plugin-owned route, /thread-share/s/<token>, outside DSH's authenticated /api: it shows only that thread's user and assistant messages (no tools, attachments or other threads), redacts secret-shaped values and home or workspace paths, is rate-limited, and sends noindex, no-store, no-referrer and a script-free CSP. The agent can list (read-only), create and revoke (explicit confirm) shares.
failureModes: A wrong, expired or revoked link gets 404 with one message telling the viewer to ask for a new link; the page never says which.

A protected share without its grant cookie shows only the passphrase form; a wrong passphrase gets 401 and the form again, and five wrong ones in 15 minutes lock the share for the rest of that window with 429 and Retry-After.
More than 120 requests a minute from one client get 429 with Retry-After; behind a loopback tunnel the forwarded client address is the key.
A live share whose thread can no longer be read (deleted, or session-controller missing) gets 503 asking the viewer to check that DSH is running.
Creating a share for an unknown thread fails with a message naming the thread id and the session-controller requirement.
Revoking an unknown id fails with a message pointing at the share list; revoke without confirm: true is refused by the schema.
A Host restart forgets passphrase grants and rate-limit windows: viewers re-enter the passphrase.

externalDependencies.boundary: Every transcript read is one sessionsApi.messages call (user and assistant text only, at most 100 messages of 8,000 characters) plus a sessionsApi.list call for the title and working directory, made in process as @dshfiles/thread-share.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: src/thread-share.test.ts mounts a sessionsApi owner with two sessions and records which ones were read.

features.title: Freeze a snapshot or download a self-contained HTML export
features.summary: A snapshot share stores the redacted transcript at creation (chunked under the 256 KiB storage value limit) and keeps showing it after the thread changes; revoking deletes it. Download HTML (and the thread_share_export tool) renders the same redacted page as one self-contained file with inline CSS, no script and no external resource, to host or upload anywhere when the Host route should not be reachable.
failureModes: Exporting an unknown thread fails with a message naming the thread id and the session-controller requirement.
Only the latest 100 messages are captured; the page says when older ones were left out.

verification.testName: freezes a snapshot share and exports a self-contained HTML file
splits a large snapshot into chunks under the storage value limit

verification.reason: Download HTML only hands the Host exportHtml answer to a browser Blob download; the Host test asserts the exported file and the share-link journey already walks the same Settings section.

features.title: Publish share pages through a time-bounded tunnel
features.summary: Settings › Thread sharing detects tailscale and cloudflared and, only after the user confirms, runs one foreground `cloudflared tunnel --url` quick tunnel or `tailscale funnel --https=8443` for 15 minutes, 1 hour or 4 hours. The tunnel targets a separate loopback listener that answers only /thread-share/… and 404s everything else, so the DSH app and its API are never published; it stops on Stop, at its deadline, or with the plugin. New share links then include the public URL. Agents can read the status and stop the tunnel; starting it has no agent tool.
failureModes: A missing CLI disables Start and names the install command.
A CLI that exits before printing a public URL (Funnel not enabled, not signed in) fails with its last output line and what to enable.
A CLI that prints no public URL within 45 seconds is stopped and reported as a timeout.
Starting while a tunnel runs stops the old one first; only one tunnel runs at a time.

externalDependencies.boundary: One foreground child process through the DSH subprocess service, pointed at http://127.0.0.1:<listener port>; its stdout/stderr are read only for the public URL and the last line on failure.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: src/thread-share.test.ts puts a shell script named cloudflared first on PATH that prints a trycloudflare.com URL and sleeps; nothing is published.
